description: Use this when the user wants the quarterly estimated tax payment due dates for 2026 (tax year 2026: Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, 2026 and Jan 15, 2027), which dates are past or next, the income period each payment covers, or calendar reminders (.ics) for those dates, with no income figures. Returns each date, days until it, and a calendar file. Does not calculate how much to pay; for amounts use plan_quarterly_payments. Do not use for state due dates or filing deadlines for the annual return.

as_of_date.description: Today's date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-03, to mark past and upcoming due dates. Defaults to today.

quarterly_amount.description: Optional amount to show on each payment reminder in USD, e.g. 2500.

reminder_days_before.description: Calendar reminder this many days before each due date, e.g. 3 (default).

name: find_estimated_tax_due_dates
title: Find estimated tax due dates
